about: The ONLY events that may place an emergency phone call to the Chairman (hq_channels.EmergencyCallAdapter). PROTECTED file (ops/PROTECTED_PATHS.json): changing it needs the Chairman's approval. Everything else goes to Telegram text. The database also enforces: calls switched off by default (jarvis_core_config.emergency_call_enabled), at most max_calls_per_day (default 2, hard limit 5), one call per dedupe key per 24 h, every decision logged in jarvis_call_log.
status: PROPOSED: awaiting the Chairman's approval of this list

kill_switch_tripped.says: the kill switch was turned on

spend_anomaly.says: spending is far above normal or running away
spend_anomaly.rule: spend in the last hour above 50 percent of the daily cap, or the cap hit before 12:00 Toronto time

production_down.rule: health check failed for 15 minutes in a row

deadline_critical.says: a time-critical deal or legal deadline needs you
deadline_critical.rule: a deadline less than 6 hours away that only the Chairman can act on

script: Hello sir, this is Jarvis with an emergency alert: {says}. Please check Telegram now. I repeat: {says}. Please check Telegram.
night_rule: 22:00-07:00 America/Toronto: only these events, and only at severity critical. Weekdays 08:00-17:00: these events only (they are all critical).
